lineage.description: Building footprints were generated using an AI/deep learning model (automated-building-detection) applied to Bing Maps imagery from approximately 2016-2019 over Izabal department, Guatemala. The model produces vector polygon predictions of individual building footprints, exported as GeoJSON in WGS84. The dataset was produced in support of DRRT Guatemala disaster response operations following hurricanes Eta and Iota.
